label: copy-phase input v (fed-back v), mid-copy of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input token is v (the model has just output v and it is fed back). This covers 100% of activations and activation mass. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases or on any other input token. But it is very sparse within that condition: under 1% of copy-phase v inputs activate it. Activity is concentrated where the v is original token 3 (recall_idx 4, about 64% of mass) in long sequences (L=9 about 72% of mass, L>=8 about 94%). It is stronger when the next output is y or v (y about 40% of mass). Restricting to v, out in {y,v}, recall_idx 4 and L>=8 raises precision only to about 0.37, and recall drops to 0.21. No simple variable separates active from inactive copy-phase v inputs, so the predicate is a necessary condition with low precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=v (+4.31), in_tok=v (+3.37), prev_tok=z (+3.01), recall_idx=4 & in_tok=v (+2.46), phase=2 & out_tok=y (+2.22), out_tok=y (+2.17).
